evidence: A sensitivity study on one lake model (biosphere/ecology/lake.py) through one GCM's climate at T21: the same runs as lake_oxygen's and the lake kinds' ladder, with the diffusivity below the mixed layer from Shih et al.'s (2005) three regimes of the buoyancy Reynolds number in place of Osborn's rule at every one, as Bouffard & Boegman (2013) carry them to lakes; the pans' share of the wind's energy at half its central value and under the first round's fixed dissipation; and Osborn's rule with the dissipation bounded near the floor. lake.py's file is unchanged: its diffusivity() and wind_dissipation() are replaced inside this process. The methane is lake_anoxia's arithmetic on the 0-15 lakes, standing for every lake. No lunar lake has been measured.
reading_rule: Oxygen in g/m3 (mg/L). comparison.lake_oxygen_convention gives the 0-15 lake in each target under Osborn's rule (lake_oxygen's product) and Shih and Bouffard's form (shih_<target>_352m_0-15, mesotrophic physics carrying every trophic state), with the lock's bounded variant; comparison.at_301k the 352 m lake and the 1,925 m giant at 301 K, each trophic state with its own physics, under Shih and Bouffard's form beside the ladder's Osborn runs; comparison.pans the 3 m pans' bracket beside lake_oxygen's central shallows. methane holds lake_anoxia's methane made in anoxic water, released at the overturns by its two rules and Moon-wide in Tg a year, from the 0-15 lake of each target under each form. runs and pans hold the summaries; the saved columns are listed with their sha256 in the index (research/runs/lake_oxygen/mixing_forms/mixing_forms_index.json), each pass a file in the lake kinds' format.
